title: 动词短语

examples.en: Please turn off the light before you leave.
The radio is too noisy. Please turn it off.
examples.zh: 收音机太吵了，请把它关掉。

guess.question: 把 turn off the light 里的 the light 换成 it，该怎么说？

options.text: turn it off——代词作宾语必须放在动词和副词中间
options.feedback: 对！turn off 是“动词 + 副词”型，代词只能放中间，放后面是错的。

options.text: turn off it——照原来的语序就行
options.feedback: 不对——代词放后面是错的，必须说 turn it off。
不对——名词可以两边放（turn off the light / turn the light off），代词只能放中间。

rule.rule: “动词 + 副词”型短语，宾语是代词时必须放在中间；宾语是名词时中间或后面都可以
rule.formula: ① 名词宾语：turn off the light = turn the light off　② 代词宾语：turn it off（只能放中间）　③ 常用短语：look after 照顾 / give up 放弃 / put up 张贴、搭建 / pick up 捡起、接人 / take off 脱下、起飞 / find out 查明

anchors.en: Please turn it off before you leave.
Don't give up. Try it again.
anchors.note: give up 是不及物用法

trap.wrong: The radio is too noisy. Please turn off it.
trap.right: The radio is too noisy. Please turn it off.
trap.why: 代词 it 必须放在 turn 和 off 中间。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——名词两边都能放，代词只能插中间：turn it off、pick it up、give it up。

check.stem: The radio is too noisy. Please ____.
check.explanation: 代词宾语放中间：turn it off。

check.stem: Don't ____. Your dream will come true one day.

options.distractor: 这里没有宾语，直接用 give up

check.stem: — Who ____ your little sister when your mother is out? — My grandma does.

options.distractor: look up 是“查阅、抬头看”
